name: Stabele Alm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Stabele Alm in Sölden**

Nestled high in the **Ötztal Alps**, the **Stabele Alm** is a true alpine paradise, offering breathtaking views of the **Tirol** landscape. Just a short drive from **Sölden**, this charming alpine hut invites you to experience the magic of the mountains in pure, unspoiled form.

**Relax & Enjoy**
After a day of hiking or skiing, unwind in our cozy **Hütte** with traditional **Tiroler** hospitality. Savor hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or a warm bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**, all made with fresh, local ingredients. In the evening, gather around the crackling fireplace with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps**—the perfect way to end a day in the mountains.

**Activities & Adventures**
Whether you're exploring the **Wildspitze** trails, skiing the slopes of **Rettenbachferner**, or simply soaking in the alpine air, **Stabele Alm** is your gateway to unforgettable experiences. In summer, enjoy alpine pastures, wildflowers, and crystal-clear mountain lakes. In winter, glide down snowy slopes or try your hand at snowshoeing under a starry sky.

**Stay with Us**
Our rustic yet comfortable rooms and private chalets provide the perfect retreat after a day outdoors. Whether you're traveling solo, with family, or with friends, **Stabele Alm** promises an authentic alpine escape.

**Plan Your Visit**
Located at **2,100 meters**, **Stabele Alm** is easily accessible by car or via the **Sölden** cable cars. Open year-round, we welcome hikers, skiers, and nature lovers alike.

**Come and experience the soul of the Alps at Stabele Alm in Sölden!**
